CO2PRISM.Title: CO2 Prism
CO2PRISM.SizeHint: Choose S, M, L or XL. Changes apply immediately.
CO2PRISM.LockedHint: Unlock to move the bar using its portrait.
CO2PRISM.NoActor: Select a single authorized token to display its actor.

Combat.Title: Combat
Combat.PartialDefense: Partial defense — coming with the action budget
Combat.FullDefense: Full defense — coming with the action budget
Combat.Uses_consumable: Remaining quantity of the consumed equipment
Combat.ConditionsUnavailable: Action unavailable: native CO2 conditions are unmet or the action is not visible.
Combat.ConditionsUnknown: Action availability could not be verified with CO2.
Combat.ShortcutControls: Click: use · Ctrl: chat · Alt: damage only when available · Shift: source sheet
Combat.DamageUnavailable: This action does not provide a damage-only roll.
Combat.ActorActionUnsupported: The installed CO2 APIs require an Item source to use or publish this actor action.
Combat.InvalidDrop: Drop rejected: selection changed, insufficient permissions, or CO2 action not found on this actor.
Combat.RemainingMovement: Remaining movement / round reference capacity, including bonuses
Combat.TimeControls: Left click: spend / Right click: grant a bonus
Combat.MixedTimeControls: Right click only: grant an AM bonus usable for A or M. Left click and keyboard: no spending.
Combat.TimeUnavailable: No compatible time available; right click to grant a bonus.
Combat.ResetBudget: Reset the round budget and remove bonuses
Combat.EconomyError: The action time budget could not be changed.
Combat.UnknownActionTime: Action refused: native CO2 action time is missing or unknown.
Combat.NoActionTime: No compatible time is available for this action.
Combat.ExecutionUnconfirmed: CO2 did not confirm this action's execution. No time was spent; check the native result.
Combat.ActionTimeConflict: Action executed, but its time could not be spent. The budget changed or could not be saved; check it manually.
Combat.FutureBudget: Action times — display only, management coming later
Combat.UnresolvedSlots: This preset has saved shortcuts; their reference format is not supported yet.
Combat.InsufficientTimeHint: No action time available: click to confirm execution without spending time.
Combat.MovementPending: Movement panel coming later — command inactive.
Combat.InsufficientTimeConfirm: You do not have enough actions available to perform this action. Do you want to trigger it anyway?

CO2PRISM.ConfigUnavailable: Configuration requires ownership of the selected actor or GM permissions.
CO2PRISM.ConfigError: The CO2 Prism configuration could not be saved. See the console for details.
CO2PRISM.CommandUnavailable: Command unavailable for the current selection, permissions or resources, or while another action is running.
CO2PRISM.RestUnavailable: Recovery unavailable: the active CO2 content has no unique fastRest/fullRest entry in its rest registry.
CO2PRISM.InvalidValue: Enter an integer between zero and the current resource maximum.
CO2PRISM.ActionError: The CO2 Prism action failed. See the console for details.

Movement.ZonesShow: Show the Tactical Zone for one M action (local snapshot)
Movement.ZonesBusy: Calculating local zones… Click the icon again to cancel.
Movement.ZonesDone: Tactical Zone: one M action, range {maxCost} cells; {states} states, {examined} transitions, {marked} cells marked, {partial} blocked/partial transitions, {elapsedMs} ms. Display frozen until next activation.
Movement.ZonesUnavailable: Zones unavailable: native pathfinding, measurement or rendering API missing/inconsistent. No approximate fallback used.
Movement.ZonesLimit: Tactical Zone stopped: range-adjusted safety limit reached (at most 50,000 states and 400,000 transitions). No incomplete result displayed.
Movement.ZonesTimeLimit: Tactical Zone stopped after 15 seconds. No incomplete result displayed; toggle it off/on to retry.
Movement.ZonesInvalidRange: Tactical Zone unavailable: invalid speed or rounding, or single-action capacity outside numeric limits.
Movement.ZonesUnsupported: Tactical Zone requires a square grid, positive token dimensions ≤ 1 × 1 and a measured action constrained by walls on the current level. Path transformations are unsupported.
Movement.ZeroBlock: Capacity for this M action: 0 cells
Movement.Finish: Validate the path: spend one movement action.
Movement.ClosurePending: {consumed} M action(s) already spent. Closure delayed: wait for the token to stop, then finish again; no further actions will be spent.
Movement.InvalidValidation: Cannot validate: native cost, grid or speed unavailable. Check the data and retry. No actions spent.
Movement.ContextChanged: Validation interrupted: the context or budget was reset. Check and retry.
Movement.ValidationFailed: Validation or saving failed. {consumed} M action(s) spent. The session remains open; check and retry.
Movement.NotificationFailed: Movement validated, but the warning could not be broadcast to other clients.
Movement.Reset: Return to the start and reset the path while keeping the session open.
Movement.ExactSummary: {used} / {capacity} cells travelled — session: {actions} / {available} available M actions.
Movement.InformativeSummary: {used} / {capacity} cells travelled — one M action session (information only).
Movement.WithinCapacity: Within available capacity: {used} cells travelled. No actions spent.
Movement.InformativeNotice: Information only — budget inactive, no M actions to spend.
Movement.Unavailable: Native cost or speed unavailable: a valid grid and native path data are required. No fallback to geometric spaces.
Movement.ReturnFailed: The command failed. The path is preserved; check token permissions and position.
Movement.Busy: Movement in progress: wait for it to stop before finishing or returning to the start.
Movement.CloseQuestion: What would you like to do?
Movement.ZonesTerrainUnavailable: Tactical Zone unavailable: native regional terrain preparation is missing or inconsistent. No approximate result displayed.
Movement.ZonesNonpositiveCost: Tactical Zone unavailable: a native transition has zero, negative or near-zero cost. No incomplete result displayed.

CO2PRISM.MovementRoundingHint: Shared table rule for rounding displayed grid cells. Distances and the action budget are unchanged.
CO2PRISM.EconomyModeHint: Display and use of the budget; changing mode does not reset it.
CO2PRISM.EconomyCombat: Visible and active only in combat
